summary: SRX Global Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 8, 2026 Limited Consent and Amendment Agreement with holders of its Series C convertible preferred stock, which was issued August 27, 2026 for $2.825 million. The Required Holders consented to and waived rights so the company may maintain a stock repurchase plan for up to the lesser of 10,000,000 shares or 50% of outstanding common stock, capped at $20 million aggregate, through July 7, 2027. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was disclosed. The consent removes a preferred-holder contractual blocker to buybacks, enabling open-market repurchases; watch actual repurchase pace versus the $20 million cap and any preferred conversion overhang pressuring the common.
